summary: Iteration 5 testing of (1) new referral leaderboard endpoint + UI and (2) $2→$1 copy updates. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (18 regression + 8 new leaderboard). Frontend: Found 2 CRITICAL runtime bugs on /app/referrals page (missing imports + missing state hooks) that completely broke the page with 'Trophy is not defined' and 'leaderPeriod is not defined' ReferenceErrors. Both fixed by testing agent. After fix, leaderboard UI works end-to-end: admin appears rank 1 with Crown icon, YOU badge, masked email ad***@vara.com, 7 friends referred, $1.23 earned; Month/All-time toggle reloads correctly. All copy updates ($1) verified on landing (hero + header), dashboard, calculator.

minor.issue: Month-start calc uses datetime(...).replace(tzinfo=None) which makes match work against naive datetimes. This only works because payouts are stored as naive UTC too — correct by coincidence. Recommend storing+comparing with timezone-aware datetimes consistently for safety.
N+1 user lookup in hydration loop (line 121-125) — one db.users.find_one per leaderboard row. Fine at 10 rows but should use $lookup or batched $in when limit grows.

'you' field populated only for callers outside top-N with a secondary aggregate counting how many referrers earned strictly more.
limit param is correctly clamped: max(1, min(limit, 50)). Tested with limit=999 → returned ≤50 rows.
401 enforcement works: /api/referrals/leaderboard without Bearer token returns 401 (via get_current_user dependency).
UI LeaderRow component correctly shows Crown(rank 1, amber), Medal(rank 2 gray, rank 3 orange) per spec.

Copy updates verified: Landing hero shows '$1 USD Bonus', header badge shows '$1 Bonus', Calculator shows '$0.10 per task' and '$1 bonus'. Exit popup intentionally still shows $2 (2× waitlist boost). Legitimate $2/$3 occurrences ($284 testimonial, $50-$200 FAQ range) are fine per instructions.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: Main agent added new leaderboard UI markup to /app/frontend/src/pages/Referrals.jsx (JSX referencing <Trophy/>, <Crown/>, <Medal/>, leaderPeriod, leaderboard, leaderYou, setLeaderPeriod) but did NOT: (a) add those icon imports to the lucide-react import statement, (b) declare the useState hooks, (c) add the useEffect to fetch /api/referrals/leaderboard. Result: React threw 'Trophy is not defined' on first render, hiding the page behind the uncaught-runtime-errors overlay. Reproduction: log in as admin, navigate to /app/referrals → red error overlay. Mitigation (applied): added imports + 3 useState hooks + fetch-leaderboard useEffect keyed on leaderPeriod.
